name: Blood Hunger

source.title: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose

disable: DC 20 Religion check (trained) to exorcise the spirit, DC 21 Religion check or DC 21 Occultism check (trained) to sever the connection between Hunger's Call and the temple, or DC 21 Crafting check (trained) to break up the pattern of the mural; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
reset: The mosaic ceases its routine 2 rounds after all living creatures are out of sight of the stairs. After 6 hours the haunt is ready to trigger again.
routine: (3 actions) The bloody mosaic blasts shards of colored glass at anyone within 10 feet of the eastern wall, and they each take 1d10 slashing damage plus 1 bleed damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save; critical success negates the bleed damage).

items.name: Hunger's Possession
items.text:
Trigger A living creature bearing Hunger's Call moves within 30 feet of the exit stairs

---

Effect Whispering voices fill the triggering creature's mind with a compulsion for blood of the living. The creature must attempt a DC 20 Will save save, and the haunt then rolls initiative.

---

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Slowed 1.

Failure The target is Slowed 2.

Critical Failure The target loses control of their mind and on their next round must move to the nearest ally and make an unarmed bite attack. The ally is Off-Guard against this attack. The bite deals 1d4 piercing damage and a critical hit deals an additional 1 bleed damage. At the end of their turn, the target regains control of their mind.

text: Blood flows from the fanged skull rune as if it were an open wound.
